title: Audio Source
description: Plays background music, sound effects, and voice clips on an entity. Supports volume channels, looping, scene persistence, fade transitions, and 2D spatial distance falloff.

blocks.content: The **Audio** component attaches an imported sound asset (**.ogg**, **.mp3**, or **.wav**) to an [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs). You can configure it as global background music that persists across scene changes, or as a positional 2D sound effect whose volume fades with distance from the camera.

items.title: Audio Channels
items.desc: Route sounds to **Background**, **Sound Effect (SFX)**, or **Voice** buses for mixer control.

items.title: Scene Persistence
items.desc: Use **Persist Across Scenes** so music continues smoothly when loading a new level.

items.title: Spatial 2D Falloff
items.desc: Attenuate sound volume automatically between **Min Distance** and **Max Distance**.

items.title: Built-in Preview
items.desc: Click the assigned filename in the inspector to audition the waveform in a popup player.

items: Select an entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and select **Audio**.
In the **Assets** panel of the bottom dock, right-click an audio file and choose **Apply to Audio Component** (or click the search icon next to **Audio File** in the inspector).

rows: Toggles **Active** or **Muted** for this audio source.
Assigns the mixer channel: **Background**, **Sound Effect (SFX)**, or **Voice**.
The assigned audio asset **ID**. Click the filename to open the waveform preview popup, or click the folder icon to pick another file.
Playback speed and pitch multiplier from 0.1 to 3.0.
Automatically starts playing as soon as the scene loads or the entity spawns.
**Destroy on Load** stops the sound when leaving the scene; **Persist Across Scenes** keeps the sound playing across scene transitions.
Smooth volume ramp-up (**In**) and ramp-down (**Out**) durations in seconds (0 to 10).
When set to **Enabled (Positional)**, volume decreases as the entity moves away from the camera.
Visible when **Spatial 2D** is enabled. Distance in pixels within which the sound plays at full volume.
Visible when **Spatial 2D** is enabled. Distance in pixels beyond which the sound fades to silence.

blocks.content: Configure seamless background music that starts automatically and keeps playing when the player moves to a new scene.

items: Create an **Empty Entity** in your starting scene, rename its **ID** to **BGM_Player**, and add an **Audio** component.
Assign your music track to **Audio File** and set **Audio Type** to **Background**.
Click **Destroy on Load** next to **Global Audio** to switch it to **Persist Across Scenes**.
Set **Fade In / Out (s)** to **1.5** for a smooth intro fade.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Audio & System](node_library/system_utilities) and [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool) to trigger sounds and control mixer channels at runtime.
